name: a collapsed sidebar keeps its layout box
why: Under MB's #page { display: table } a collapsed sidebar stays a table cell as wide as its min-content: the page runs past the table and every pinned bar stops that far short of the window edge (2026-10-14, area page).

name: no bleed rule: pinned bars end short of the window edge
why: Rows scrolling under a vertically stuck h2/h3 showed in the strip between the capped bar and the window edge.
grep: reach the window edge in their own colour

name: the bleed is computed as 0
why: The strip is gutter + margin-right wide; a zero width paints nothing.

edits.find: const w = Math.min(max, Math.max(0, parentRight - scrollX - right));

grep: reach the window edge in their own colour

name: the bleed has a fixed width (to the window edge at every scroll position)
why: The first version: at maximum scroll the data h2 and the h3 bars painted past the table's end, under the sidebar handle, while the Wikipedia h2 stopped at it (reported 2026-10-14).

edits.find: const w = Math.min(max, Math.max(0, parentRight - scrollX - right));

name: a horizontal scroll does not resize the bleed
why: The bleed depends on scrollX; only the scroll listener updates it between refresh passes.

name: the bleed property does not inherit
why: The bar's ::after reads --mb-sph-bleed and only ever sees an inherited value of its originating element: non-inherited, its width is 0 (the first version of this fix).
grep: reach the window edge in their own colour

name: the inheriting bleed is written on tables too
why: --mb-sph-bleed inherits: written on a table pinned whole, every cell would carry it and a change would restyle the whole table.

edits.find: return { el, baseZ: false, table, inline: false, left: Math.max(0, _sphFloor2(left)), width: null, bleed: null };
edits.replace: return { el, baseZ: false, table, inline: false, left: Math.max(0, _sphFloor2(left)), width: null, bleed: { el, right: 0, parentRight: 1e6, max: 20 } };

name: the sticky thead has no backing colour
why: A sorted column's header tint is 60 % alpha; on the non-MusicBrainz sites nothing was behind it, and rows scrolling under the pinned header showed through (2026-10-14, brucespringsteen.it).
